#Project Question:
Can historical player performance predict next-season points per field-goal attempt better than repeating the previous season?

##Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE
)
```

```{r settings}
#Run the code below to change players

    #c("PLAYER_NAME", "PLAYER_ID")
  #]

player_id <- 1641717L
player_name <- "Cason Wallace"

# Season ending years: 2026 means 2025–26.
```

##Loading season statistics

```{r}
load_player_season <- function(year) {

  dir.create(
    "data/development_raw",
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  file_name <- paste0(
    "player_season_stats_", year, ".csv"
  )

  local_path <- file.path(
    "data/development_raw",
    file_name
  )

  url <- paste0(
    "https://github.com/sportsdataverse/",
    "sportsdataverse-data/releases/download/",
    "nba_stats_player_season_stats/",
    file_name
  )

  if (!file.exists(local_path)) {

    previous_timeout <- getOption("timeout")

    on.exit(
      options(timeout = previous_timeout),
      add = TRUE
    )

    options(timeout = max(300, previous_timeout))

    tryCatch(
      download.file(
        url = url,
        destfile = local_path,
        method = "libcurl",
        mode = "wb"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        unlink(local_path)
        stop(
          "Download failed for ", year, ": ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      }
    )
  }

  # Reading and cleaning stay INSIDE the function.
  raw <- read.csv(
    local_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "player_id", "player_name", "season", "age",
    "season_type", "measure_type", "per_mode",
    "gp", "min", "fgm", "fga", "fg3m", "fg3a",
    "ftm", "fta", "ast", "reb", "tov"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(raw)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  data <- subset(
    raw,
    season_type == "regular-season" &
      measure_type == "base" &
      per_mode == "totals"
  )

  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    stop("No regular-season totals found for ", year)
  }

  data <- data[, required_columns, drop = FALSE]

  stopifnot(
    all(data$season == year),
    !anyNA(data$player_id),
    !anyDuplicated(data$player_id)
  )

  message(
    "Loaded ", nrow(data),
    " player-season rows for ", year
  )

  return(data)
}
```

##Development Features

```{r development-feature}
#Dividing it safely
safe_ratio <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  result <- rep(NA_real_, length(denominator))
  
  valid <- is.finite(numerator) &
    is.finite(denominator) &
    denominator > 0
  
  result[valid] <- numerator[valid] / denominator[valid]
  result
}

development_data <- player_seasons

#checking shooting totals before calculating the features
shooting_columns <- c(
  "fgm", "fga", "fg3m", "fg3a", "ftm", "fta"
)

stopifnot(
  all(complete.cases(
    development_data[, shooting_columns, drop = FALSE]
  )),
  all(as.matrix(
    development_data[, shooting_columns, drop = FALSE]
  ) >= 0),
  all(development_data$fgm <= development_data$fga),
  all(development_data$fg3m <= development_data$fg3a),
  all(development_data$fg3m <= development_data$fgm),
  all(development_data$fg3a <= development_data$fga),
  all(development_data$ftm <= development_data$fta)
)

development_data$two_point_makes <- with(
  development_data, fgm - fg3m
)

development_data$two_point_attempts <- with(
  development_data, fga - fg3a
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    development_data$two_point_makes <=
      development_data$two_point_attempts
  )
)

development_data$field_goal_points <- with(
  development_data, 2 * fgm + fg3m
)

development_data$points_per_attempt <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(field_goal_points, fga)
)

development_data$two_point_pct <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(two_point_makes, two_point_attempts)
)

development_data$three_point_pct <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(fg3m, fg3a)
)

development_data$free_throw_pct <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(ftm, fta)
)

development_data$three_point_share <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(fg3a, fga)
)

development_data$minutes_per_game <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(min, gp)
)

development_data$attempts_per_game <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(fga, gp)
)

development_data$assists_per_game <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(ast, gp)
)

development_data$rebounds_per_game <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(reb, gp)
)

development_data$turnovers_per_game <- with(
  development_data,
  safe_ratio(tov, gp)
)
```

##Consecutive Season Pairs

```{r consecutive-season-pairs}
# Create a separate table containing future outcomes.
next_season <- development_data[, c(
  "player_id", "season", "gp", "fga",
  "points_per_attempt"
)]

names(next_season) <- c(
  "player_id", "target_season", "next_gp", "next_fga",
  "next_points_per_attempt"
)

# Match a future season to the season immediately before it.
next_season$season <- next_season$target_season - 1L
next_season$next_season_recorded <- TRUE

development_pairs <- merge(
  development_data,
  next_season,
  by = c("player_id", "season"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

development_pairs <- development_pairs[
  order(development_pairs$season, development_pairs$player_id),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  nrow(development_pairs) == nrow(development_data),
  !anyDuplicated(
    development_pairs[, c("player_id", "season")]
  )
)

# The last loaded season has no observed next-season outcomes.
historical_pairs <- subset(
  development_pairs,
  season < max(season_years)
)

historical_pairs$has_next_season <- (
  !is.na(historical_pairs$next_season_recorded)
)

historical_pairs$has_next_efficiency <- (
  historical_pairs$has_next_season &
    is.finite(historical_pairs$next_points_per_attempt)
)

pair_coverage <- aggregate(
  cbind(
    current_player_seasons = rep(1L, nrow(historical_pairs)),
    next_season_recorded = as.integer(
      historical_pairs$has_next_season
    ),
    next_efficiency_available = as.integer(
      historical_pairs$has_next_efficiency
    )
  ) ~ season,
  data = historical_pairs,
  FUN = sum
)

pair_coverage$next_efficiency_unavailable <- with(
  pair_coverage,
  current_player_seasons - next_efficiency_available
)

knitr::kable(pair_coverage, row.names = FALSE)

# Keep the latest season separately for future projections.
forecast_candidates <- subset(
  development_data,
  season == forecast_year - 1L
)

# Inspect the selected player's matched outcomes.
player_pair_review <- subset(
  historical_pairs,
  player_id == as.integer(player_id)
)

knitr::kable(
  player_pair_review[, c(
    "player_name", "season", "fga",
    "points_per_attempt", "target_season",
    "next_fga", "next_points_per_attempt"
  )],
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

##Modeling Sample

```{r Modeling-sample}
# Require a meaningful amount of current-season shooting.
minimum_current_attempts <- 200L

modeling_data <- historical_pairs[
  is.finite(historical_pairs$fga) &
    historical_pairs$fga >= minimum_current_attempts &
    is.finite(historical_pairs$points_per_attempt) &
    is.finite(historical_pairs$next_points_per_attempt),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# The change we will eventually report for each player.
modeling_data$efficiency_change <- with(
  modeling_data,
  next_points_per_attempt - points_per_attempt
)

# Confirm that each outcome comes from the following season.
stopifnot(
  nrow(modeling_data) > 0L,
  all(modeling_data$target_season == modeling_data$season + 1L),
  !anyDuplicated(modeling_data[, c("player_id", "season")])
)

sample_counts <- aggregate(
  list(player_season_pairs = rep(1L, nrow(modeling_data))),
  by = list(target_season = modeling_data$target_season),
  FUN = sum
)

knitr::kable(
  sample_counts,
  caption = "Eligible player-season pairs by outcome season"
)
```

##Development time splits

```{r development-time-splits}
# Split by the season being predicted, not the current season.
training_target_end <- 2023L
validation_target_years <- c(2024L, 2025L)
test_target_year <- 2026L

development_train <- modeling_data[
  modeling_data$target_season <= training_target_end,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

development_validation <- modeling_data[
  modeling_data$target_season %in% validation_target_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

development_test <- modeling_data[
  modeling_data$target_season == test_target_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Check that every split contains data and follows time order.
stopifnot(
  nrow(development_train) > 0L,
  nrow(development_validation) > 0L,
  nrow(development_test) > 0L,
  max(development_train$target_season) <
    min(development_validation$target_season),
  max(development_validation$target_season) <
    min(development_test$target_season)
)

# Display the size and outcome years of each split.
split_summary <- data.frame(
  dataset = c("Training", "Validation", "Final test"),
  player_season_pairs = c(
    nrow(development_train),
    nrow(development_validation),
    nrow(development_test)
  ),
  earliest_target_year = c(
    min(development_train$target_season),
    min(development_validation$target_season),
    min(development_test$target_season)
  ),
  latest_target_year = c(
    max(development_train$target_season),
    max(development_validation$target_season),
    max(development_test$target_season)
  )
)

knitr::kable(split_summary)
```

##Development baseline

```{r development-baseline}
# Predict that each player's efficiency stays the same.
development_validation$baseline_prediction <-
  development_validation$points_per_attempt

# A reusable function for evaluating numerical predictions.
regression_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {

  if (
    length(actual) != length(predicted) ||
    length(actual) == 0L ||
    any(!is.finite(actual)) ||
    any(!is.finite(predicted))
  ) {
    stop("Actual and predicted values must be finite and equal in length.")
  }

  error <- predicted - actual

  data.frame(
    mae = mean(abs(error)),
    rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2)),
    bias = mean(error)
  )
}

baseline_results <- cbind(
  data.frame(model = "Previous-season efficiency"),
  regression_metrics(
    actual = development_validation$next_points_per_attempt,
    predicted = development_validation$baseline_prediction
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  baseline_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Validation performance: points per field-goal attempt"
)
```

##Regression model

```{r development-predictors}
# Explicitly list the information available when forecasting.
predictor_columns <- c(
  "age",
  "gp",
  "fga",
  "points_per_attempt",
  "two_point_pct",
  "three_point_pct",
  "free_throw_pct",
  "three_point_share",
  "minutes_per_game",
  "attempts_per_game",
  "assists_per_game",
  "rebounds_per_game",
  "turnovers_per_game"
)

stopifnot(
  all(predictor_columns %in% names(development_train)),
  all(vapply(
    development_train[, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  ))
)

# Learn replacement values using TRAINING data only.
training_medians <- vapply(
  development_train[, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE],
  function(x) {
    usable <- x[is.finite(x)]

    if (length(usable) == 0L) {
      stop("A predictor has no finite training values.")
    }

    median(usable)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

# Prepare any dataset using the same predictors and medians.
prepare_predictors <- function(data) {

  predictors <- data[, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE]

  # Record missing values before replacing them.
  missing_flags <- as.data.frame(
    lapply(predictors, function(x) {
      as.integer(!is.finite(x))
    })
  )

  names(missing_flags) <- paste0(
    predictor_columns,
    "_missing"
  )

  # Replace missing or infinite values with training medians.
  for (column in predictor_columns) {

    missing <- !is.finite(predictors[[column]])

    predictors[[column]][missing] <-
      training_medians[[column]]
  }

  as.matrix(cbind(predictors, missing_flags))
}

x_train_full <- prepare_predictors(development_train)
x_validation_full <- prepare_predictors(development_validation)

# Remove columns that never vary in training.
varying_columns <- apply(
  x_train_full,
  2,
  function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1L
)

model_feature_names <- colnames(x_train_full)[varying_columns]

x_train <- x_train_full[
  ,
  model_feature_names,
  drop = FALSE
]

x_validation <- x_validation_full[
  ,
  model_feature_names,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Store the outcomes separately from the predictors.
y_train <- development_train$next_points_per_attempt
y_validation <- development_validation$next_points_per_attempt

stopifnot(
  nrow(x_train) == length(y_train),
  nrow(x_validation) == length(y_validation),
  identical(colnames(x_train), colnames(x_validation)),
  all(is.finite(x_train)),
  all(is.finite(x_validation)),
  all(is.finite(y_train)),
  all(is.finite(y_validation))
)

# Inspect the resulting matrices.
predictor_summary <- data.frame(
  dataset = c("Training", "Validation"),
  rows = c(nrow(x_train), nrow(x_validation)),
  predictors = c(ncol(x_train), ncol(x_validation))
)

knitr::kable(predictor_summary)

print(model_feature_names)
```

##Development Elastic net

```{r development-elastic-net}
library(glmnet)

# Try three mixtures of ridge and lasso penalties.
alpha_values <- c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75)

elastic_net_fits <- vector("list", length(alpha_values))
tuning_results <- vector("list", length(alpha_values))

for (i in seq_along(alpha_values)) {

  # Fit a sequence of penalty strengths using training data.
  fit <- glmnet(
    x = x_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "gaussian",
    alpha = alpha_values[i],
    standardize = TRUE,
    nlambda = 100
  )

  elastic_net_fits[[i]] <- fit

  # Each column contains predictions for one lambda.
  predictions <- as.matrix(
    predict(
      fit,
      newx = x_validation,
      s = fit$lambda,
      type = "response"
    )
  )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(predictions) == length(y_validation),
    ncol(predictions) == length(fit$lambda)
  )

  # Calculate one set of metrics for each fitted lambda.
  scores <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(seq_along(fit$lambda), function(j) {

      predicted <- as.numeric(predictions[, j])
      error <- predicted - y_validation

      data.frame(
        mae = mean(abs(error)),
        rmse = sqrt(mean(error^2)),
        bias = mean(error)
      )
    })
  )

  tuning_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fit_index = rep(i, length(fit$lambda)),
    alpha = rep(alpha_values[i], length(fit$lambda)),
    lambda = fit$lambda,
    mae = scores$mae,
    rmse = scores$rmse,
    bias = scores$bias
  )

} # Close the loop AFTER saving this alpha's results.

# Combine results from all three alpha values.
elastic_net_tuning <- do.call(rbind, tuning_results)
rownames(elastic_net_tuning) <- NULL

# Rank settings by MAE, using RMSE to break ties.
elastic_net_tuning <- elastic_net_tuning[
  order(elastic_net_tuning$mae, elastic_net_tuning$rmse),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

best_elastic_net_settings <- elastic_net_tuning[
  1,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

best_elastic_net <- elastic_net_fits[[
  best_elastic_net_settings$fit_index
]]

best_lambda <- best_elastic_net_settings$lambda

# Save predictions from the selected settings.
development_validation$elastic_net_prediction <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    best_elastic_net,
    newx = x_validation,
    s = best_lambda,
    type = "response"
  )
)

# Compare elastic net with the previous-season baseline.
elastic_net_results <- cbind(
  data.frame(model = "Elastic net"),
  regression_metrics(
    actual = y_validation,
    predicted = development_validation$elastic_net_prediction
  )
)

validation_comparison <- rbind(
  baseline_results,
  elastic_net_results
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    best_elastic_net_settings[, c("alpha", "lambda"), drop = FALSE],
    digits = 6,
    caption = "Selected elastic net settings"
  )
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    validation_comparison,
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Validation performance: points per field-goal attempt"
  )
)
```

##Elastic net coefficients

```{r elastic-net-coefficients}
#Extracting coefficients at the selected penalty strength
coefficient_matrix <- as.matrix(
  coef(
    best_elastic_net,
    s = best_lambda
  )
)

coefficient_table <- data.frame(
  predictor = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coefficient_matrix[, 1]),
  row.names = NULL
)

#Separating the intercept from the predictor coefficients
predictor_coefficients <- coefficient_table[
  coefficient_table$predictor != "(Intercept)",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

#Training standard deviations help compare numerical predictors
training_sd <- apply(x_train, 2, sd)

predictor_coefficients$training_sd <- unname(
  training_sd[predictor_coefficients$predictor]
)

#Predicted difference associated with a one-SD increase
predictor_coefficients$effect_per_sd <-
  predictor_coefficients$coefficient *
  predictor_coefficients$training_sd

#Expressing the difference as points per 100 field goal attempts
predictor_coefficients$points_per_100_per_sd <-
  100 * predictor_coefficients$effect_per_sd

#Order by the size of the standardized coefficients
predictor_coefficients <- predictor_coefficients[
  order(
    abs(predictor_coefficients$effect_per_sd),
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

print(
  knitr::kable(
    best_elastic_net_settings[, c("alpha", "lambda"), drop = FALSE],
    digits = 6,
    caption = "Selected elastic net settings"
  )
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    predictor_coefficients[
      ,
      c("predictor", "coefficient", "points_per_100_per_sd"),
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Elastic net coefficients"
  )
)
```

```{r development-xgboost}
library(xgboost)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_train,
  label = y_train
)

dvalidation <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_validation
)

xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(1L, 2L, 3L),
  nrounds = c(100L, 300L),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
)

xgb_fits <- vector("list", nrow(xgb_grid))
xgb_scores <- vector("list", nrow(xgb_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(xgb_grid))) {

  fit <- xgb.train(
    params = list(
      objective = "reg:squarederror",
      eta = 0.03,
      max_depth = xgb_grid$max_depth[i],
      min_child_weight = 20,
      subsample = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 0.8,
      lambda = 1,
      seed = 2026,
      nthread = 1
    ),
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = xgb_grid$nrounds[i],
    verbose = 0
  )

  xgb_fits[[i]] <- fit

  predictions <- as.numeric(
    predict(fit, newdata = dvalidation)
  )

  xgb_scores[[i]] <- regression_metrics(
    actual = y_validation,
    predicted = predictions
  )
}

# Combine settings with their validation scores.
xgb_tuning <- cbind(
  data.frame(fit_index = seq_len(nrow(xgb_grid))),
  xgb_grid,
  do.call(rbind, xgb_scores)
)

# Select the lowest validation MAE.
xgb_tuning <- xgb_tuning[
  order(xgb_tuning$mae, xgb_tuning$rmse),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

rownames(xgb_tuning) <- NULL

best_xgb_settings <- xgb_tuning[1, , drop = FALSE]

best_xgb <- xgb_fits[[
  best_xgb_settings$fit_index
]]

development_validation$xgb_prediction <- as.numeric(
  predict(best_xgb, newdata = dvalidation)
)

xgb_results <- cbind(
  data.frame(model = "XGBoost"),
  regression_metrics(
    actual = y_validation,
    predicted = development_validation$xgb_prediction
  )
)

# Compare all three approaches on identical validation rows.
validation_comparison <- rbind(
  baseline_results,
  elastic_net_results,
  xgb_results
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    xgb_tuning,
    digits = 4,
    caption = "XGBoost settings and validation results"
  )
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    validation_comparison,
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Validation model comparison"
  )
)
```

###Final test

```{r development-final-test}
x_test_full <- prepare_predictors(development_test)

x_test <- x_test_full[
  ,
  model_feature_names,
  drop = FALSE
]

y_test <- development_test$next_points_per_attempt

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(x_train), colnames(x_test)),
  nrow(x_test) == length(y_test),
  all(is.finite(x_test)),
  all(is.finite(y_test))
)

# Baseline: predict no change in efficiency.
development_test$baseline_prediction <-
  development_test$points_per_attempt

# Use the elastic net settings selected on validation.
development_test$elastic_net_prediction <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    best_elastic_net,
    newx = x_test,
    s = best_lambda,
    type = "response"
  )
)

test_baseline_results <- cbind(
  data.frame(model = "Previous-season efficiency"),
  regression_metrics(
    actual = y_test,
    predicted = development_test$baseline_prediction
  )
)

test_elastic_net_results <- cbind(
  data.frame(model = "Elastic net"),
  regression_metrics(
    actual = y_test,
    predicted = development_test$elastic_net_prediction
  )
)

final_test_comparison <- rbind(
  test_baseline_results,
  test_elastic_net_results
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    final_test_comparison,
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Final test: predicting 2025–26 efficiency"
  )
)
```

##Development Test Bootstrap

```{r development-test-bootstrap}
# Each final-test row should represent a different player.
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(development_test$player_id)
)

# Calculate each player's absolute prediction errors.
baseline_absolute_error <- with(
  development_test,
  abs(baseline_prediction - next_points_per_attempt)
)

elastic_net_absolute_error <- with(
  development_test,
  abs(elastic_net_prediction - next_points_per_attempt)
)

# Negative differences favor elastic net.
player_error_difference <-
  elastic_net_absolute_error - baseline_absolute_error

stopifnot(
  length(player_error_difference) > 0L,
  all(is.finite(player_error_difference))
)

# Resample players while preserving the paired model errors.
set.seed(2026)

bootstrap_mae_difference <- replicate(5000, {

  selected_rows <- sample.int(
    n = length(player_error_difference),
    size = length(player_error_difference),
    replace = TRUE
  )

  mean(player_error_difference[selected_rows])
})

# Percentile bootstrap interval.
interval <- quantile(
  bootstrap_mae_difference,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  names = FALSE
)

bootstrap_comparison <- data.frame(
  comparison = "Elastic net minus baseline MAE",
  observed_difference = mean(player_error_difference),
  lower_95 = interval[1],
  upper_95 = interval[2]
)

# Express the results in points per 100 field-goal attempts.
bootstrap_comparison[, c(
  "observed_difference", "lower_95", "upper_95"
)] <- 100 * bootstrap_comparison[, c(
  "observed_difference", "lower_95", "upper_95"
)]

print(
  knitr::kable(
    bootstrap_comparison,
    digits = 3,
    caption = "MAE difference: points per 100 field-goal attempts"
  )
)
```

Elastic net reduced held-out MAE from 8.49 to 8.15 points per 100 field-goal attempts. The paired bootstrap estimate for elastic net minus baseline MAE was −0.34, with a 95% interval of −0.77 to +0.10, indicating uncertainty around the modest improvement.

##Final refit

```{r development-final-refit}
final_training_data <- modeling_data[
  modeling_data$target_season < forecast_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Update imputation values using the full historical sample.
final_medians <- vapply(
  final_training_data[, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE],
  function(x) {

    usable <- x[is.finite(x)]

    if (length(usable) == 0L) {
      stop("A predictor has no finite historical values.")
    }

    median(usable)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

# Separate preparation function for the forecasting model.
prepare_final_predictors <- function(data) {

  predictors <- data[, predictor_columns, drop = FALSE]

  missing_flags <- as.data.frame(
    lapply(predictors, function(x) {
      as.integer(!is.finite(x))
    })
  )

  names(missing_flags) <- paste0(
    predictor_columns,
    "_missing"
  )

  for (column in predictor_columns) {

    missing <- !is.finite(predictors[[column]])

    predictors[[column]][missing] <- final_medians[[column]]
  }

  full_matrix <- as.matrix(cbind(predictors, missing_flags))

  # Preserve the feature set chosen during model development.
  full_matrix[, model_feature_names, drop = FALSE]
}

x_final <- prepare_final_predictors(final_training_data)
y_final <- final_training_data$next_points_per_attempt

stopifnot(
  nrow(x_final) == length(y_final),
  all(is.finite(x_final)),
  all(is.finite(y_final))
)

# Include the selected lambda in a decreasing penalty sequence.
refit_lambdas <- sort(
  unique(c(best_elastic_net$lambda, best_lambda)),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

final_elastic_net <- glmnet::glmnet(
  x = x_final,
  y = y_final,
  family = "gaussian",
  alpha = best_elastic_net_settings$alpha,
  lambda = refit_lambdas,
  standardize = TRUE
)

message(
  "Refitted model using ",
  nrow(final_training_data),
  " historical player-season pairs."
)
```

```{r development-player-forecast}
# Select the player's season immediately before the forecast.
player_forecast_data <- development_data[
  development_data$player_id == player_id &
    development_data$season == forecast_year - 1L,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(player_forecast_data) != 1L) {
  stop("Expected exactly one current-season row for this player.")
}

if (
  !is.finite(player_forecast_data$fga) ||
  player_forecast_data$fga < minimum_current_attempts
) {
  stop("This player does not meet the current-season attempt threshold.")
}

x_player <- prepare_final_predictors(player_forecast_data)

predicted_efficiency <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    final_elastic_net,
    newx = x_player,
    s = best_lambda,
    type = "response"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  length(predicted_efficiency) == 1L,
  is.finite(predicted_efficiency)
)

forecast_season_label <- paste0(
  forecast_year - 1L,
  "–",
  sprintf("%02d", forecast_year %% 100L)
)

player_forecast <- data.frame(
  player = player_forecast_data$player_name,
  forecast_season = forecast_season_label,
  previous_season_attempts = player_forecast_data$fga,
  previous_points_per_attempt =
    player_forecast_data$points_per_attempt,
  predicted_points_per_attempt = predicted_efficiency,
  predicted_change_per_100 = 100 * (
    predicted_efficiency -
      player_forecast_data$points_per_attempt
  )
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    player_forecast,
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Selected player: next-season efficiency forecast"
  )
)
```

The model projects Cason Wallace to score approximately 1.04 points per field-goal attempt in 2026–27, broadly unchanged from 1.036 in 2025–26. The projected increase of 0.37 points per 100 attempts is small relative to the model’s historical prediction error.

##player development prediction interval

```{r development-player-prediction-interval}
# Signed errors from the model evaluated on the held-out season.
# Positive means actual efficiency exceeded the prediction.
test_residuals <- with(
  development_test,
  next_points_per_attempt - elastic_net_prediction
)

stopifnot(
  length(test_residuals) > 0L,
  all(is.finite(test_residuals))
)

# Estimate the lower and upper tails of historical errors.
residual_limits <- quantile(
  test_residuals,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  names = FALSE
)

# Add those historical errors to the player's point forecast.
# Efficiency is bounded between 0 and 3 points per attempt.
player_forecast_interval <- player_forecast

player_forecast_interval$approx_lower_95 <- pmax(
  0,
  player_forecast_interval$predicted_points_per_attempt +
    residual_limits[1]
)

player_forecast_interval$approx_upper_95 <- pmin(
  3,
  player_forecast_interval$predicted_points_per_attempt +
    residual_limits[2]
)

# Express the interval as change from previous-season efficiency.
player_forecast_interval$change_lower_per_100 <- 100 * (
  player_forecast_interval$approx_lower_95 -
    player_forecast_interval$previous_points_per_attempt
)

player_forecast_interval$change_upper_per_100 <- 100 * (
  player_forecast_interval$approx_upper_95 -
    player_forecast_interval$previous_points_per_attempt
)

print(
  knitr::kable(
    player_forecast_interval[
      ,
      c(
        "player",
        "forecast_season",
        "predicted_points_per_attempt",
        "approx_lower_95",
        "approx_upper_95",
        "predicted_change_per_100",
        "change_lower_per_100",
        "change_upper_per_100"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Forecast with approximate historical-error interval"
  )
)
```

Cason Wallace’s projected 2026–27 efficiency is approximately 1.04 points per field-goal attempt, broadly unchanged from the previous season. An approximate historical-error interval of 0.81–1.29 indicates considerable uncertainty, providing little basis to predict a clear improvement or decline.


```{r development-player-forecast-chart, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_development_forecast <- function() {

  # Select the player's historical seasons.
  history <- development_data[
    development_data$player_id == player_id &
      development_data$season < forecast_year &
      is.finite(development_data$points_per_attempt),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  history <- history[order(history$season), , drop = FALSE]

  stopifnot(
    nrow(history) > 0L,
    nrow(player_forecast_interval) == 1L
  )

  forecast <- player_forecast_interval

  # Convert efficiency to points per 100 attempts.
  historical_value <- 100 * history$points_per_attempt
  forecast_value <- 100 * forecast$predicted_points_per_attempt
  lower_value <- 100 * forecast$approx_lower_95
  upper_value <- 100 * forecast$approx_upper_95

  years <- c(history$season, forecast_year)

  season_labels <- paste0(
    years - 1L,
    "–",
    sprintf("%02d", years %% 100L)
  )

  # Restore graphics settings after plotting.
  previous_settings <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(previous_settings), add = TRUE)

  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))

  value_range <- range(
    historical_value,
    lower_value,
    upper_value
  )

  padding <- max(5, diff(value_range) * 0.15)

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(min(years) - 0.3, max(years) + 0.3),
    ylim = value_range + c(-padding, padding),
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Season",
    ylab = "Points from field goals per 100 attempts",
    main = paste0(
      forecast$player,
      ": historical efficiency and forecast"
    )
  )

  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = years,
    labels = season_labels
  )

  abline(
    h = axTicks(2),
    col = "gray90",
    lty = 1
  )

  # Observed historical efficiency.
  lines(
    history$season,
    historical_value,
    type = "b",
    pch = 16,
    col = "#0072B2",
    lwd = 2
  )

  # Dashed connection from the latest observation to the forecast.
  segments(
    x0 = tail(history$season, 1),
    y0 = tail(historical_value, 1),
    x1 = forecast_year,
    y1 = forecast_value,
    col = "#D55E00",
    lty = 2,
    lwd = 2
  )

  # Approximate historical-error interval.
  arrows(
    x0 = forecast_year,
    y0 = lower_value,
    x1 = forecast_year,
    y1 = upper_value,
    code = 3,
    angle = 90,
    length = 0.08,
    col = "#D55E00",
    lwd = 2
  )

  points(
    forecast_year,
    forecast_value,
    pch = 18,
    cex = 1.5,
    col = "#D55E00"
  )

  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = c(
      "Observed",
      "Forecast",
      "Approximate 95% historical-error interval"
    ),
    col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#D55E00"),
    pch = c(16, 18, NA),
    lty = c(1, NA, 1),
    lwd = c(2, NA, 2),
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.8
  )

  mtext(
    "Forecast conditional on next-season participation and field-goal attempts.",
    side = 1,
    line = 3.5,
    cex = 0.75
  )
}

plot_development_forecast()
```
